name: remy
description: Run Claude Code on your machines from anywhere.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix mobile install
scripts.dev:server: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix server start
scripts.build: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix desktop run build
scripts.pack:mac: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix desktop run pack:mac
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix desktop run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile run typecheck
